title: HR Operations Administrator
description:
Are you the person who gets satisfaction from clearing the inbox, solving the query, completing the paperwork and knowing everything has actually been finished?

We are looking for a bright, organised and resourceful HR Operations Administrator to join a busy HR team.

This role is all about keeping things moving.

A significant part of your day will involve managing the HR mailbox, responding to straightforward employee queries, finding information, signposting people to the right place and making sure requests do not disappear into the system.

What will you be doing?

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing and responding to queries through the HR mailbox
- Providing first-line HR information to employees
- Signposting more complex queries to the appropriate colleague
- Preparing routine HR documentation
- Supporting starters, leavers and contractual changes
- Maintaining accurate employee records
- Supporting absence and probation processes
- Liaising with payroll and HR colleagues
- Tracking actions and deadlines
- Updating HR systems
- Researching answers when information is not immediately available
- Making sure queries and tasks are followed through to completion

The organisation uses Unit 4 ERPx, so experience of Unit 4 would be a real bonus, although it is certainly not essential.

The person we are looking for

You do not need to know everything.

What matters is what you do when you do not know the answer.

Do you sit and wait for someone to tell you, or do you look at the policy, check the system, find the right person, ask the question and get the issue resolved?

We want the latter.

You will need:
- Previous HR administration or HR operations experience
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- Confidence dealing with employees and colleagues
- Strong written communication skills
- Good general HR knowledge
- The ability to work quickly without sacrificing accuracy
- Confidence using and learning HR systems
- Initiative and common sense
- The ability to prioritise a busy workload
- A strong sense of personal responsibility for deadlines

Most importantly, you will be someone who finishes things.

If you say you will get something done, you get it done. If there is a problem, you raise it. If you do not know something, you find out.

Who could this suit?

Perhaps you are an experienced HR Administrator or HR Coordinator who genuinely enjoys operational HR and is not chasing the next management title.

Alternatively, you may be earlier in your HR career but exceptionally capable, quick to learn and confident working independently.

Either could work.

What matters most is that you are proactive, reliable, responsive and comfortable working in a busy environment where you will need to use your own initiative.

title: HR Recruiter
description:
Job Purpose:

We are looking for an In-House Recruiter to support end-to-end hiring, working closely with managers to recruit high-quality candidates while maintaining strong relationships and a positive candidate experience.

Key Responsibilities:
- Complete end-to-end recruitment.
- Be actively involved in recruitment by preparing job descriptions, posting adverts across job boards, LinkedIn, and internal channels.
- Managing the hiring process with respective managers.
- Source candidates via LinkedIn, CV databases, and referrals.
- Screen CVs and conduct initial phone/video interviews.
- Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
- Manage candidate communication and provide timely feedback.
- Organise and participate in the Job Interview process, prepare offer letter, contract, and onboarding of new employees.
- Perform DBS, DBS Renewal, reference check and other suitable checks as needed and create ID & maintain all employee records for staff.
- To develop, implement and maintain HR documents such as Employee handbook, letters, offer letters, contracts, New Starter form and other documents and ensure compliance with all relevant legislation.
- Coordinate with managers to allot mandatory training required by the company.
- Provide induction as necessary and inform payroll about starters and leavers for each month.
- Maintain accurate records in the ATS (Applicant Tracking System) to provide a monthly report on recruitment to Directors.
- Liaising with Agency staff on a regular basis for eligible candidates and negotiating the rates.
- Advise managers and employees on right to work and vetting and barring requirements relating to employment, and oversee appropriate actions are taken, including submission of certification of sponsorship applications and vetting and barring applications as appropriate.
- Provide references such as Employee reference, VISA and immigration reference, Housing /Mortgage renting reference, and Council request.

Person Specification:
- Previous HR experience in an office setting required.
- Excellent IT skills, i.e. Microsoft Word, Excel, and other commonly used software
- Good oral and written communication skills
- Ability to follow directions.
- Professional, friendly, and detail oriented.
- Organised, reliable and flexible.
- Confident using email, calendars, and basic system.
- An effective team player
- Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
- Ability to work on own initiative, demonstrates organisational skills.
- Conduct initial phone screens to create shortlists of qualified candidates.
- Interview candidates in-person for a wide range of roles (junior, senior and executive).
- Track hiring metrics including time-to-hire, time-to-fill and source of hire.
- Host and participate in job fairs.
- Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
- Maintain a database of potential candidates for future job openings.
- Screening prospective job applicants to evaluate their skills and qualifications.
- Confident using email, calendars, and basic systems

title: HR Administrator
description:

We are looking for an enthusiastic HR Administrator to join the team on an ongoing temp contract for approximately 6 months. Providing valuable day-to-day support to the HR Manager across a broad range of HR activities; this is a varied role that would suit someone who enjoys working in a busy environment, has excellent attention to detail and is confident managing confidential information and multiple priorities.

You'll play an important role across HR administration, recruitment, onboarding, DBS and compliance, training and development, payroll support and general HR projects, with training provided where required.

Recruitment & Onboarding

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
